You have one metric in your local data: **steps** from Google, which is the only record set on this machine.

**Steps (Google, activity)**
- Unit: count (daily totals)
- 3 days of data, from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-03
- No records have been deleted upstream.

**Denied**
- Google **sleep** was denied. The recorded reason is "Synthetic permissions denied," last updated 2026-10-31.

**Unsupported or unparsed**
- Google **body** (weight) has one file the importer could not read ("Synthetic unknown weight format"). The raw file is kept on disk.

**No local records** (not yet imported, not granted, or genuinely empty; this does not mean zero)
- Fitbit: activity, body, cardio fitness, ECG, exercise, heart, IRN, nutrition, sleep, SpO2/breathing/temperature
- Google: blood glucose, body, cardio fitness, ECG, exercise, heart, IRN, nutrition, reproductive health, sleep, SpO2/breathing/temperature, symptoms and mood

**Connection status**
- Neither provider is connected. Google has no token and no ghealth CLI credentials were found. Fitbit has no token and is not configured.
- Fitbit's legacy Web API was scheduled to shut down on 2026-10-30, so a Fitbit connection may not work even if you set one up.
- Google's test-mode tokens expire after 7 days, so you may need to run `ghealth auth login` again.

The steps data covers only three days, so it is too little to summarize. If you want more history, connect Google (or import a Takeout export if API access isn't available) and I can pull it in.
